youtube_title: Army Officer Buyer Sends a QR to Pay You? Scam of the Week #10 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #10. You list your old bike online. A buyer says he's an army officer posted far away and will pay the full amount on UPI. Then he sends a QR code: scan it and enter your PIN to receive the money. A: scan it. B: it's a scam?
Answer: B. You never scan a QR or enter a UPI PIN to receive money. Entering the PIN sends YOUR money out. Then comes 'Oops, mistake, scan this for a double refund', and the loop continues. Army ID cards and uniform photos can be fake. Deal face to face in a public place.
Scammed? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Sources: Cyberabad Cyber Crimes Wing and Navi Mumbai Police advisories.
